sources.title: Plant Disease Detection Algorithm Based on Efficient Swin Transformer
sources.snippet: This model is an improvement over the Swin-T architecture, incorporating two pivotal modules: the Selective Token Generator and the Feature Fusion Aggregator. The Selective Token Generator minimizes the number of tokens processed, significantly increasing computational efficiency and facilitating multi-scale feature extraction.

sources.snippet: This project leverages Swin Transformers, an advanced Vision Transformer (ViT) model, for plant leaf disease detection. By analyzing leaf images, the model can classify diseases and help in early-stage detection for improved crop management.
